= title-code(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-05
:source-highlighter: rouge

== Name

title-code - titles above highlighted code

== Synopsis

.H01 Default title *bold* (C) and \*literal*
[source,rust]
----
let default = "(C)";
----

.H02 Disabled title (R) and pass:[(TM)]
[source,rust,subs="-replacements"]
----
let disabled = "(R)";
----

.H03 Enabled title (TM)
[source,rust,subs="+replacements"]
----
let enabled = "(TM)";
----

H04 Following prose (C).
